verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence never documents an open-source distribution or a way to self-host the Statsig platform. Warehouse Native runs experiment analysis in your own warehouse, and SDKs evaluate locally after initialization. Both are adjacent features, not a self-hosted open-source flag platform.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure
